reference_population.description: Synthetic decisions included in the monthly demonstration dataset.
reference_population.selection_rationale: The demonstration population is bounded to records shipped with the repository so results remain reproducible.
reference_population.data_boundary: Synthetic records only; no production applicants or institutional data.

correlation_assumptions: Recorded drivers are treated as reviewer inputs, not causal estimates.
No independence among recorded drivers is asserted.
aggregation_rationale: Reasons retain record-level rank and are summarized only for governance review counts.
known_limitations: The method records supplied drivers and does not reproduce a trained model's internal attribution process.
The demonstration does not establish legal sufficiency of any notice reason.
